sections.heading: Meeting FEMA P-320 and ICC-500 Standards in Denison
sections.html:
At Texoma Storm Shelters, we adhere strictly to the highest safety guidelines established by the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA P-320) and the International Code Council (ICC-500). These standards are crucial for ensuring your storm shelter can withstand the extreme forces of a tornado, providing a truly safe haven for you and your loved ones.

For Denison residents, this means your shelter is engineered to resist severe wind loads and flying debris, offering proven protection. We meticulously follow these guidelines during every step of the installation process, from site preparation to anchoring, ensuring your shelter meets or exceeds these critical life-safety benchmarks.

  • FEMA P-320: Provides guidance for constructing safe rooms.
  • ICC-500: Establishes minimum design and construction requirements for storm shelters.
